name: paged
description:
Two-page cursor walk over devices-detailed. NinjaOne pages with an opaque `after` cursor and the script hard-codes pageSize=500, so a full 500-record page is the only thing that can trigger a second call; page one is exactly 500 records and page two is short. Proves the second request carries after=<id of the last record on page one> (1500) and that the short second page ends the walk without a third call.

Invariant namespaced_ids is skipped because this integration emits the bare NinjaOne device id as the foreign id with no tenant or instance scope; that defect is reported separately rather than worked around here.
